episodes.separation: Cnew episodes appear in no training pool of either arm; the old held-out episodes stay held out

BROAD.construction: R replay with its turn / north-leg dense paths removed and the BROAD anchors' paths added (recorded 2 draws w 1.0, sample0 / sample1 8 draws w 0.25 each); every other path verbatim

seeds.note: all bases distinct from every earlier stream (r1, hold-out, validate, ABC, arms R/COV, fresh-untouched); candidate stride 7919 checked

budget.critics: 2 arms x 3 seeds x 30k NCE, random init, V6_ANCHOR_WEIGHTS=audit, one GPU (node 30021)
budget.expected_wall: rollouts ~15 min (15 workers), critics ~15 min, analysis ~10 min
budget.storage: BROAD replay ~1.7 GB, Cnew outcomes < 1 MB

evaluation.primary: Cnew: 64 anchors on 30 reserved detour episodes, candidates recorded + mode + 3 samples, 16 paired draws; region-integrated readout (arm's own weighted marginal), agreement on identical decided pairs, pick gain as in the diagnostic, ties / weak reported, per seed, paired episode bootstrap NARROW vs BROAD
evaluation.development: the existing C set (diag_r1_abc); A / B reclassified: turn / north-leg A anchors are NARROW keys, not BROAD keys
evaluation.criterion: BROAD improves Cnew pick gain over NARROW by > 2 paired s.e., with positive absolute pick gain and consistent per-seed direction; agreement corroborates; three training seeds limit the training-randomness side of the uncertainty
evaluation.actor_stage: only if the criterion passes: both arms, pure-BC init, frozen critics, bc 0.05, 30k, 300 matched episodes

cnew_diag_manifest.diagnostic: Cnew held-out anchors (reserved detour episodes of the new shards)

continuation.mode: frozen deployment policy, tanh(loc) mode, closed-loop from step 2
